title: The Girlfriend Who Never Existed
narrativeQuestion: How did a girlfriend who never existed become one of the biggest sports stories of 2012, and how was the truth found?

chapters.title: A Girl on the Phone
chapters.claim: Te'o began an online and phone relationship with Lennay Kekua in October 2011 and never met her in person.

chapters.title: One Week in September
chapters.claim: His grandmother really died on September 11, 2012. Lennay's reported death the next day and funeral on September 22 were invented.

chapters.title: Everybody Told the Story
chapters.claim: Major outlets repeated the story from September 2012 to January 2013 without checking any record.

chapters.title: Run the Background Check
chapters.claim: Deadspin's January 16, 2013 report found no death, school, obituary or photo record for Lennay Kekua.

chapters.title: Who Was Lennay?
chapters.claim: Naya Tuiasosopo, then known as Ronaiah, created and voiced Lennay. The photos belonged to Diane O'Meara, who never met Te'o.

namedPeople.name: Naya Tuiasosopo
namedPeople.role: creator of the Lennay Kekua persona

chapters.title: What the Story Was Worth
chapters.claim: Te'o finished second in the Heisman with 1,706 points, lost the title game 42 to 14, and fell to 38th in the 2013 draft.

accuracyNotes: Te'o's 2010 photo is used because no openly licensed 2012 photo was available.
Photos of Diane O'Meara are not committed. She appears only in her own CNN interview.
Heisman points are the official 2012 totals reported by the Associated Press.
